[SWS_PER_00303]
d
The
Persistency
shall be able to store serialized binary data
in a
Key-Value Storage
.
Persistency
shall accept serialized binary data in the
form of an
ara::core::Vector
of
ara::core::Byte
or an
ara::core::Span
of
ara::core::Byte
.
c
(RS_PER_00001)
This allows the
application
to store custom data types.
Please note that an
ara::core::Span
of
ara::core::Byte
cannot be returned
by
ara::per::KeyValueStorage::GetValue
. It can only be passed in to
ara::per::KeyValueStorage::SetValue
and
ara::per::KeyValueStor-
age::GetValue
with
out
parameter.
